about: Amorepacific Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and trades cosmetics and beauty products worldwide. It offers cosmetics under the Sulwhasoo, Laneige, Innisfree, AP Beauty, Hera, Primera, Iope, Mamonde, Hanyul, espoir, Etude, Odyssey, Be Ready, Holitual, Tata Harper, and Cosrx brands; medical beauty products under the Aestura brand; beauty devices under the maekON brand; and inner beauty products under the VitalBeautie brand. The company also provides hair beauty products under the Ryo, Mise-en-Scène, Labo-H, Ayunche, Amos Professional, and Longtake brands; body care products under the Illiyoon, Hapy Bath, and Skin U brands; dental care products under the Median and Gentist brands; and tea products under the Osulloc brand. In addition, it engages in the manufacture and sale of detergent, and organic and inorganic compounds; manufacture, processing, and trade of food and other products; product packaging and facility management; and equipment design and production. The company is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
